domain_title: Data, privacy, confidentiality and intellectual property
title: Convenience-driven data accumulation
canonical_definition: Data is collected, transmitted or retained because it may be useful rather than because it is necessary.

conditions: All systems processing organizational, personal, customer or third-party information.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Does the case exhibit Convenience-driven data accumulation: Data is collected, transmitted or retained because it may be useful rather than because it is necessary.
Do implemented workflows, data paths or operations show whole-database copies, full documents sent when fields suffice, or missing deletion propagation?
Does current evidence test presence or scoped absence of Convenience-driven data accumulation, or does it remain unknown?

antipattern_indicators: Whole databases copied for narrow use
Full documents sent when fields suffice
More context is assumed to be inherently better

conditions: Refer verified convenience-driven data accumulation to the accountable authority before progression where the condition materially affects the requested operating scope.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, MAP 1.6 (PDF p. 31), MEASURE 2.10 (PDF p. 35)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on deriving system requirements from context and examining privacy risk. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

failure_mechanism: The declared or implemented control can be unreliable where data is retained or transmitted for speculative future usefulness without a current necessity decision. The mechanism can have an operational effect where an observed request sends an entire record when approved fields suffice, or a deleted record remains available through a downstream store.
potential_consequences: Unnecessary information can persist or circulate beyond the purpose needed for the service.

atomic_tests.test: Compare the effective governance and design records. Determine whether data is retained or transmitted for speculative future usefulness without a current necessity decision. Identify the system scope and the record that supports each conclusion.

Trace actual configurations or activity for the assessed release. Determine whether an observed request sends an entire record when approved fields suffice, or a deleted record remains available through a downstream store. Attribute each observation to the specific path, time and decision.

Independently review field-by-field sampling and a deletion exercise with independent checks of stores, providers and derived data. Record whether each material mechanism was tested, the observed result and the scope limitations.

required_evidence.title: Effective design and governance records
required_evidence.description: Review the versioned owner decision and relevant specifications for evidence of whether data is retained or transmitted for speculative future usefulness without a current necessity decision. Preserve material conflict and applicability context.

required_evidence.title: Observed condition or enforcement trace
required_evidence.description: Use effective configuration or dated operational records to determine whether an observed request sends an entire record when approved fields suffice, or a deleted record remains available through a downstream store. Identify the version, affected paths and period represented.

required_evidence.title: Executed scoped comparison
required_evidence.description: Provide field-by-field sampling and a deletion exercise with independent checks of stores, providers and derived data. Include current scope, expected results, observed results, retained evidence and unresolved cases.

required_evidence.title: Independent review and limitations
required_evidence.description: An independent reviewer confirms the assessed version, completeness of coverage, result, limitations and whether a material change requires a new test.

required_artifacts: Field-by-field sampling and a deletion exercise with independent checks of stores, providers and derived data.
Current version and scope with all material failure paths and cases identified.
Expected and observed results, attributable records, and independent review of coverage and residual limitations.

sufficiency: Presence requires affirmative evidence for a material mechanism. Examine whether data is retained or transmitted for speculative future usefulness without a current necessity decision, and separately check whether an observed request sends an entire record when approved fields suffice, or a deleted record remains available through a downstream store. A supported mechanism may establish presence within its evidenced scope.
Keep unresolved or contradictory mechanisms UNKNOWN and preserve the competing records. Refer material interpretation conflicts to the accountable human authority.

Use TESTED_ABSENT only after a current, executed, successful and independently verified evaluation covers all material paths within scope. Use field-by-field sampling and a deletion exercise with independent checks of stores, providers and derived data. Reassess when material changes affect that scope.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A document can identify a declared gap. Effective configuration can demonstrate a reachable condition. Observed records support only their covered period and workflow. TESTED_ABSENT requires the complete scoped absence contract.
false_positive_guards: A justified scoped and time-limited exception within the authorized purpose is distinguishable from accumulation by default.
Confirm that the observed or alleged condition applies to the current assessed release and a reachable path.
prohibited_inferences: A gap or UNKNOWN in B2 alone cannot establish AP-B2 presence.
Missing complaints, incident silence and unsuccessful collection cannot establish absence.
Model output and tactic selection grant no authority to approve, close a finding or accept risk.

finding_definitions.title: Design or intent shows convenience-driven data accumulation
Implementation or operating evidence shows convenience-driven data accumulation
Presence or tested absence of convenience-driven data accumulation is unresolved within scope
